guidelines: Preserve fail-closed safety boundaries; do not silence or weaken the quality-architecture detector.

intent.problem: PR #541 correctly failed Hosted template-smoke: the short platform entry checker added literal parent-directory link strings, which the repository quality architecture intentionally classifies as unsafe path traversal literals. The original platform-documentation Work Item is archived and its PR is closed without merge.
constraints: Create an independent corrective Work Item and replacement PR; do not edit immutable archive evidence or merge PR #541.
Do not weaken path-traversal detection, skip Hosted CI, or replace exact link validation with a weaker check.
Retain the approved short iOS, Android, and Java entry pages in English, Chinese, and Japanese.
Under the temporary user-approved exception, run focused local regression checks and all governance gates rather than a redundant full local quality suite.
intent.rationale: Constructing expected link paths without unsafe literal source patterns preserves both controls: documentation navigation is checked, while the quality architecture remains able to reject unsafe repository code.
